purpose: freeze what pilot data may inform sample-size planning without leaking the focal architecture-by-access effect

allowed_nuisance_inputs: within-individual binary-response ICC or equivalent repeated-trial correlation from architecture-neutral/procedural or full-information pilot conditions
full-information B3 success rate as a procedural learnability diagnostic
timeout / abandonment fraction for response-window calibration
colony heterogeneity for later final GLMM simulation
forbidden_inputs: the exact theoretical 0.25 information-ceiling interaction used as a behavioral effect size
pilot.unblinding_rule: pilot nuisance values used for final planning must be frozen before the focal architecture-by-access contrast is opened

sesoi.meaning: smallest probability-scale H1/H2 interaction worth detecting in the behavioral experiment

conservative_screening.cell_balance: equal individuals in all 12 architecture x access x budget cells
conservative_screening.counterbalance_rounding: randomized individuals per cell rounded up to a multiple of four

final_sample_size_gate.required_before_collection: replace screening approximation with simulation of the frozen binomial mixed model using pilot nuisance parameters, colony allocation, response-window timeout process and externally frozen SESOI

claim_boundary: The calculator can expose implausibly small or large designs and enforce provenance/firewalls. It does not constitute the final powered sample-size justification.
